messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-east-1 queue_length > 300 for 6m; autoscaler attempted scale but hit scale_limit. Potential throughput degradation. Pager: maria-oncall.

maria-oncall: taking pager. joining. any immediate customer reports? :eyes:

ajay-runtime: i'm on logs. queue growth started ~1839001200 after the midnight deploy to runtime-v2. seen autoscaler request -> rejected by quota check (scale_limit=8).

kevin-sre: confirmed. autoscaler log shows 'scale_request=+6 nodes, allowed=0, reason=scale_limit_reached' and then backpressure propagated to queue.

naomi-mlops: noticed a config change in continuous_batching yesterday: max_batch_tokens was increased to 8192 in the rollout which can push longer assembly times -> reduces throughput in high-concurrency small requests. that plus prefix cache miss rate spike.

maria-oncall: customer impact? cs-amy can you summarize?

cs-amy: multiple Dedicated customers on east region reporting 5xx and 429s; internal alerts show p50->p95 latency from 120ms -> 2.6s and 10% error rate for some routes. I flagged top 3 customers to AMs.

ajay-runtime: dumping recent metrics. paste:
```
2026-03-15T00:16Z prefix_cache_hit_rate: 12% -> baseline 84%
2026-03-15T00:18Z queue_length: 22 -> 312
2026-03-15T00:19Z continuous_batching.assemble_time_ms.p95: 310 -> 1280
2026-03-15T00:20Z autoscaler.scale_attempts: 3 -> 6 (last rejected)
```

naomi-mlops: prefix cache miss jump suggests key namespace changed. I saw a hash-salt bump in the recent model-runtime image (tag runtime-v2.4.1) that can change cache keys for prefix-based KV. likely regression.

kevin-sre: mitigation path: 1) temporarily lower continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens to 2048 2) increase prefix_cache.ttl and fall back to previous runtime image on a subset 3) request emergency scale limit bump from infra quotas or shift traffic to west region.

maria-oncall: i'm going to enact 1 & 2 now. ajay help with config patch and hot-restart? naomi try to validate cache key change. cs-amy hold customer comms -- callouts in 15m after we have action timeline.

ajay-runtime: applying patch to pool config (reduce max_batch_tokens). command:
```bash
# patch continuous batching
kubectl -n runtime patch cm gpu-pool-config --type merge -p '{"continuous_batching":{"max_batch_tokens":2048}}'
# trigger hot worker restart
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart daemonset/gpu-worker
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for daemonset/gpu-worker: 1/12 updated. logs streaming...

maria-oncall: also increasing prefix_cache.ttl from 60s -> 300s as stopgap. naomi, is there a simple revert for the hash-salt?

naomi-mlops: hash-salt is baked into runtime image env var PREFIX_CACHE_SALT. quick revert = roll back to runtime-v2.4.0 on a canary subset (10% traffic) and watch hit rate. preparing image rollback.

kevin-sre: request to infra for temporary scale_limit increase filed (INC-4432). pinged infra-quotas. if they approve, we can scale to relieve queue while we stabilize config.

ajay-runtime: rollout status: 6/12 updated, assembly_time p95 already dropping on updated nodes. queue growth slowing.

maria-oncall: handoff note for night oncall: if autoscaler rejects again, apply traffic-shift to west-region route in router-config (route priority: west first for high-latency-sensitive customers). leaving thread open until full stabilization.

cs-amy: sending initial customer note: "We experienced elevated latencies and transient errors in east region due to capacity autoscaling limits and a batching config mismatch. We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a timeline."

naomi-mlops: can confirm prefix_cache_hit_rate on canary (runtime-v2.4.0) is back to 82% after rollback.

ajay-runtime: autoscaler quota bump approved for 2h -> scale_limit temporarily 12. scaling triggered +4 nodes. queue draining.

deploy-bot: daemonset/gpu-worker rollout complete: 12/12 updated.

kevin-sre: monitoring: queue_length -> 18, p95 latency -> 210ms, error_rate -> 0.6%. good.

maria-oncall: root cause summary: rollout of runtime-v2.4.1 introduced PREFIX_CACHE_SALT change causing prefix cache misses; combined with an aggressive increase to continuous_batching.max_batch_tokens and a hard-scale_limit on autoscaler resulted in queue growth and throttling.

maria-oncall: action items: [naomi -> bake fix removing salt bump or add migration], [ajay -> add a runtime preflight to assert prefix_cache_hit_rate after deploy], [kevin -> request permanent autoscaler quota increase and add alert for scale_limit rejections], [cs-amy -> customer incident follow-up].

maria-oncall: handing off to kevin-sre for overnight watch. if anything spikes, page me. handing off at 1839002720. :wave:

kevin-sre: taking over. will keep monitoring dashboards and coordinate with infra if needed. closing thread when stable for 1h.
